import pandas as pd

# Ensure the Score column is of numeric type
df['Score'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Score'], errors='coerce')

# Group by the Score column and increment by 1 for each duplicate value
df['Score'] = df.groupby('Score')['Score'].transform(lambda x: x + (x.nunique() > 1)) + 0.1

# Round the Score column to 1 decimal place
df['Score'] = df['Score'].round(1)
